# @three-ws/spatial-mcp

> Validator, builder, and conformance fixtures for Spatial MCP — the open (CC0) shape for returning a live, interactive 3D scene as a first-class MCP tool result.

@three-ws/spatial-mcp is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/spatial-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/spatial-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/spatial-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/spatial-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/spatial-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
